name: Wheat HD-3086 seeds (10 kg)
shortDescription: Popular HD-3086 wheat variety for timely Rabi sowing in the north-west plains.
longDescription: HD-3086 gives a strong tillering response with adequate irrigation and suits the 140–145 day window of the Indo-Gangetic plain. Currently out of stock for this season.
cultivationGuide: Sow between late October and mid-November
Give first irrigation at crown-root initiation
Harvest at full maturity to avoid shattering
